controller.title: Who provides the service
controller.body: Luma is operated by [company name, tax id and address to be defined]. By creating an account you accept these terms.

service.title: What Luma is
service.body: Luma helps you discover nearby restaurants and shops, see their menus and deals, place orders and pick them up in store. Luma does not prepare or deliver products: each business is responsible for what it sells.

accounts.title: Your account
accounts.body: You must be of legal age and give true information. You are responsible for keeping your password safe. You can delete your account at any time from your Profile.

orders.title: Orders and prices
orders.body: Orders are picked up in store. The server computes the final price from the menu and the deals valid when you confirm; the business may reject an order. You pay on pick-up until online payment is available.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.body: Whoever registers a business declares they may represent it and that what they publish is true: name, address, location, hours, menu, prices and deals.

verification.title: Business verification and suspension
verification.body: Luma reviews businesses before showing them (legal data, tax id and documents) to prevent false information. It may ask for changes, reject or suspend a business that breaks these terms or receives well-founded reports, and tells the owner why.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Do not use Luma for fraud, fake orders, offensive content or to obtain other people's data. We may suspend accounts that do.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Luma works to keep information accurate, but each business's data is published by its owner. [Scope of liability to be defined with legal advice.]

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If we change these terms we will tell you in the app and, when the law requires it, ask for your acceptance again.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Write to [contact email to be defined].

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: [Company name, tax id, address and email to be defined], under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013.

data.title: What data we process
data.body: Email and password (encrypted), full name, mobile number (required for businesses, optional for customers), your orders, favourites and reviews. We never ask for your address: orders are picked up in store. Luma never receives card data.

purposes.title: What we use it for
purposes.body: Creating and protecting your account, handling your orders, sending you codes and service notices, verifying businesses and handling reports. We do not sell your data or use it for third-party advertising.

location.title: Your location
location.body: Only with your permission, to show you what is nearby. It is used on your device and in proximity queries; we keep no history of your locations. You can deny or withdraw the permission at any time.

sharing.title: Who it is shared with
sharing.body: The business you order from sees your order and your display name, never your email, phone or id. We use infrastructure providers (hosting and database) that process data on our behalf.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, update and correct your data, ask for proof of your consent, know how it is used, withdraw consent or ask for deletion, and complain to the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC).

exercise.title: How to exercise them
exercise.body: From your Profile you can edit your data and delete your account. For other requests write to [contact email to be defined]; we answer queries within 10 business days and claims within 15.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: While you keep your account. When you delete it we erase your profile, favourites, reviews and files; orders are kept anonymised for the business's records.

security.title: Security
security.body: Encrypted connections, data access restricted per account, and private verification documents visible only to their owner and the review team.

minors.title: Minors
minors.body: Luma is for adults. If we learn an account belongs to a minor, we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We will tell you in the app before an important change takes effect.
